verdict.rationale: Anthropic Skills is a skill-packaging format and ecosystem, not itself an agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question. The pack contains no evidence of one. The MCP material covers other things: Claude Code connecting to external MCP servers as a client, plugins bundling MCP servers, and the Agent SDK letting developers define their own in-process MCP tools. None of these is a first-party MCP server that exposes Skills for agents to connect to.
